_doc: DERIVED from ncr-2253-newwest.png through tools/ncr-2253-extract.py, using the registration in ncr-2253-georef.json. De jure claim and de facto control as SEPARATE channels, which is what this sheet uniquely carries. EVERY feature is dated 2253 and is NOT current state: Misfits' present is about 2302, forty-nine years later.

extraction.survivalNote: Percent of colour-matched pixels that survive an opening of radius 3. A genuine fill survives 90%+. A channel far below that is matching line work rather than territory - this is how the Brotherhood swatch was caught claiming every graticule hairline and place label on the sheet.

deJure.note: The hatched extent, not the full area the drawn border encloses. The sweep has two plateaus - 6-8 merges hatch strokes, 10-14 floods the border curve's interior - and the sheet hatches only part of what its border surrounds. Treat as a lower bound.
